dated_only.description: Only tasks with a due, scheduled or start date.

filter.description:
Only tasks whose line contains this text, e.g. `#task` (the Obsidian
Tasks global filter). It is removed from the title.

link.description:
Makes each task a link: `{path}` is the file's path under the folder
in `paths`, `{line}` the task's line. E.g.
`obsidian://open?vault=Notes&file={path}`.

paths.description: Markdown files, or folders to search for them. `~/` is expanded.

entries.description: Open Markdown tasks (- [ ]) from your notes, in the Obsidian Tasks format: due, scheduled and start dates, priorities and #tags. Overdue first.
entries.name: Tasks
